title: Livestock Treatment Inspection Log
subtitle: Livestock Treatment: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Livestock Treatment Inspection Log covers animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition. The livestock care record owner records Livestock Treatment check times, results, excursions, and review. Livestock Treatment Inspection Log keeps Livestock Treatment exceptions visible until the livestock care record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Livestock Treatment Inspection Log at pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location. Document animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition identity before Livestock Treatment begins. Compare animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition findings with stated Livestock Treatment criteria; route unresolved Livestock Treatment issues to veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer. For Livestock Treatment Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Livestock Treatment. Ask veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer to review Livestock Treatment conditions beyond the livestock care record owner's role.

sections.title: Recorder, location, and log identity
sections.guidance: For Livestock Treatment, identify responsible parties, pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location, and the linked animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition source.

sections.guidance: Capture Livestock Treatment facts for animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Livestock Treatment log excursions; have livestock care record owner record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.guidance: Pause Livestock Treatment when animal identity, treatment authority, dose, adverse response, withdrawal, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Livestock Treatment proof and route unresolved animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition scope to livestock care record owner.
